set.body:
Current plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md, Full event-graph delivery. Owner approved proceeding 2026-11-16.

Scope: Reuse the film compiler and existing story/document/recall types. DL2 source records propose source events; DL1 details propose recall events; DL3 bindings remain inspectable. Do not make every atom a new occurrence. Preserve participant roles, place/time, original IDs and exact evidence. The first slice uses the root-only compiler with explicit Held gaps.

Engineering acceptance artifact: One paired synthetic account passes the public film/recall construction and mapping path: several details about one occurrence, a summary spanning occurrences and a non-episodic detail remain distinguishable, with original IDs/support and unresolved associations conserved. Boundary controls refuse foreign source/recall identities.

Scope is one bounded synthetic account and its public path, not a whole-corpus extraction. Use repository reference-scope gates, relevant mutation/compile-refusal evidence and exact-SHA cold review. Graph-wide integration and fresh-data qualification remain on the existing E0 and human-evaluation tickets. Claim this slice, not a parent container.
set.title: [event-graph] Join detail accounts to source and recall events
